evidence: Touches `CMakeLists.txt` and `cmake/secp256k1.cmake` to pass compiler and linker hardening flags to the secp256k1 subtree, carrying the 'Build system' label.
rationale: Missing hardening flags in secp256k1 cause linkers to strip binary-wide hardware control-flow protections (such as AArch64 BTI/PAC/GCS or x86_64 CET) from the final `bitcoind` executable. Author verification confirms that on aarch64 Ubuntu 26.04, `bitcoind` lacks the AArch64 feature note entirely because secp256k1 objects lack it, directly weakening release binary hardening.
